explication: Pipenv manages a project’s Python environment and dependencies: users invoke CLI commands that update the Pipfile, resolve and lock dependency versions, install packages into a virtualenv, and can then inspect or run the environment. The graph also captures documented project discovery, shell/.env support, dependency checks, and the bundled pip installation layer. Edges use README statements or SOURCE INDEX references; several internal implementation details are unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
